pageDescription: Control the startup state of essential Windows services. Turn on to enable automatically at boot, turn off to stop.
startAllSuccess: All services enabled and set to automatic startup.
restartRequiredBody: Changes will fully apply after restarting Windows.
footerNote: Enabling a service sets its startup type to Automatic, ensuring it runs on every Windows restart.
missingTooltip: This service does not exist on this Windows installation.
servicePcaSvcDescription: Detects and fixes compatibility issues when installing programs and older applications.
serviceDpsDescription: Runs automatic system diagnostics and schedules maintenance scans.
serviceDiagTrackDescription: Collects usage and diagnostic data to send to Microsoft. Disabling reduces data collection.
serviceSysMainDescription: Improves application load time by pre-loading frequently used programs.
serviceEventLogDescription: Records system events such as startup, errors, and security warnings.
serviceAdpSvcDescription: Aggregates device diagnostic data and cleans temporary files in the background.
serviceUmRdpDescription: Redirects devices like printers and drives in Remote Desktop sessions.
